text:
Tess: quick thread on the latency panel prototype. p95 is hard to read when the panel is narrow. options? stronger stroke, filled area, or tiny marker at right?
Jon: stronger stroke + small marker is my vote. filled area competes with throughput shading.
Amina: agree. also, the time-range presets collapse the sampling selector which resets to 'auto' 1% of user tests were surprised. can we persist sampling per-user?
Rafael: per-user persistence (localStorage) is simplest. per-dashboard would be ideal but heavier.
Tess: ok localStorage it is. copy for tooltip when sampling is active? current: "Auto" is vague.
Jon: tooltip: "Auto chooses sampling to limit cost while keeping distribution representative." short title: "Sampling: auto (approx. 10%)"
Amina: accessibility: avoid red/green. use hue shift (teal->indigo) and add optional patterns in legend for colorblind users.
Rafael: pattern toggle default off, remember preference. also add aria-labels for patterns so screen readers get "Sampled"/"Full".
Tess: heatmap bins: they look wrong across ranges. propose adaptive bin widths (1m for 1h, 5m for 6h, 15m for 24h) and show "Bins: 5m" in legend with tooltip.
Jon: good. export note: include bin width and sampling rate in CSV headers.
ops-bot: reminder 1:00 UTC design sync: agenda includes sparkline visibility, sampling persistence, heatmap bins.
Tess: thanks all 680
